items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: I think Percy was with Harry Walker... Percy can tell you how great he is... I think they'd be up here... if I'm not mistaken.

ctx.x: Did they ever have any five string banjo players around here?
Well, hmm, sometime later they had quite a few. Then Percy came in, and I think that Percy came in, had, I think Percy was with Harry Walker.
